name: runway-ios
description: Native iOS shell for Runway (Capacitor). Bundles the web app, adds native speech recognition and local notifications.

scripts.setup: npm run prepare-www && npx cap add ios && node scripts/patch-ios.mjs && npx @capacitor/assets generate --ios --iconBackgroundColor '#3B5BDB' --splashBackgroundColor '#F6F5F2' && npx cap sync ios
scripts.update: npm run prepare-www && npx cap sync ios
